PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT (?e_emotionLabel AS ?emotionLabel) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?a_lemma) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
    VALUES ?a_lemmaType { lila:Lemma lila:Hypolemma }
    ?a_lemma a ?a_lemmaType .
    ?a_lemma ontolex:writtenRep ?a_wr .
  }
  ?e_elitaLemma ontolex:canonicalForm ?a_lemma .
  ?e_elitaLemma elita:HasEmotion ?e_emotion .
  ?e_emotion rdfs:label ?e_emotionLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?e_emotionLabel
ORDER BY ASC(?count)

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT (?e_emotionLabel AS ?emotionLabel) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?a_lemma) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
    VALUES ?a_lemmaType { lila:Lemma lila:Hypolemma }
    ?a_lemma a ?a_lemmaType .
    ?a_lemma lila:hasPOS lila:noun .
    ?a_lemma ontolex:writtenRep ?a_wr .
  }
  ?s_itToSicEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?a_lemma ;
               vartrans:translatableAs ?s_sicEntry .
  ?s_sicEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?s_sicLemma .
  ?s_sicLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
           ontolex:writtenRep ?s_sicWR .
  ?e_elitaLemma ontolex:canonicalForm ?a_lemma .
  ?e_elitaLemma elita:HasEmotion ?e_emotion .
  ?e_emotion rdfs:label ?e_emotionLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?e_emotionLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
